description: This PHP trait, HasDataTrait, provides implementation for data management features such as iteration, array access, counting, and conversion to array, for classes that use it. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the internal data array, enabling foreach iteration.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the value at the specified offset, allowing for indirect modifications.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value at the specified offset in the internal data array.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes the value at the specified offset from the internal data array.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the internal data array.
